title: Glòria, our guide, was...
text: Glòria, our guide, was fantastic! She was super personable and knowledgeable and made sure we had a great experience. Highly recommend!
author: JOSH_F

title: Awesome tour!
text: Our tour guide was Adriano and would recommend him highly. Very energetic and highly knowledgeable.  Direct with the information, answered all our questions, took pictures for us and kept the tour very interesting.  Was not boring at all. Would definitely book this again with him and others as well
author: Janice A

title: Personalized tour was so worth it.
text: Daria was an excellent guide.  Her passion and knowledge made for a wonderful experience.  We would highly recommend your tour.
author: v5cfdqqtbj

title: Olga
text: Olga was the best guide ever. Super attentive to my needs.  I would highly recommend her as your guide.
author: Gail_D

title: Amazing experience. Unconditionally recommend.
text: Josep was amazing. Great communication on where to meet. So knowledgeable about this subject and kept the tour interesting and entertaining while teaching us. I can say enough good things about this experience. I would unconditionally recommend this experience to anyone who wants to see these two places only. It was next to impossible finding any tour that did not include Sagrada Famila, which we had seen separately.
author: Michael_M

title: Olga E, highly recommended!
text: Olga Escribano was a spectacular guide!! He shared his knowledge masterfully.  We will repeat with her for another destination in Barcelona.
author: irmarier2025

title: Great but…
text: This was a great way to fully immerse and absorb some gaudi education while feasting with your eyes his beautiful work. We were disappointed not to be taken to the facades of the gatehouses in the park guell due to time pressure of getting to the second part of our tour to the magnificent experience of touring Casa Batllo. We suggested it possibly be better to see the casa first then we could’ve stayed in the park to explore the park further on our tickets.
author: rosroyle
